title: Indeed with hardship [will be] ease
arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا، إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
latin: Fa inna ma'al 'usri yusra, inna ma'al 'usri yusra
translation: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
lesson: Ease is not after hardship, but with it. The repetition is not redundant - it's assurance. Look for ease already present in hardship.
